To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we suggest a method to estimate the unbiased efficient frontier and that the method is useful for testing the significance of the efficient frontier in a portfolio selection problem.
we derive an unbiased sample efficient frontier estimator and an exact F-test for testing efficient frontiers.
we provide a new estimator of the efficient portfolio and a test for the efficient portfolio.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the estimation of the efficient frontier, the derivation of a test on the efficient frontier, and the correction of the overoptimism in sample efficient frontiers.
the estimation of the efficient frontier and the statistical inference on the efficient frontier.
the statistical analysis of portfolio optimization.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the sample efficient frontier is a biased estimator of the efficient portfolio.
, in general, the sample efficient frontier is overoptimistic and the proposed method corrects this overoptimism.

the sample efficient frontier, the sample minimum variance portfolio, and the sample Sharpe ratio, are not consistent estimators of the true efficient frontier, the true minimum variance portfolio, the true Sharpe ratio, respectively.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed an estimator of the efficient portfolio which is unbiased and consistent and we have derived an F-test on the efficiency of the frontier.
the unbiased estimator of the frontier is more accurate and the exact F-test is more powerful.
the sample efficient frontier can be unbiasedly estimated by a linear regression.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the sample efficient frontier is not the best unbiased estimator of the true efficient frontier.
the sample efficient frontier is biased and that the bias is due to the estimation error of the mean-variance portfolio weights.
the unbiased estimator of the sample efficient portfolio is not only more accurate than the sample efficient frontier, but also more robust to the presence of outliers.
